tasks.title: Compose the envlint CLI in bin/envlint.mjs

acceptance_criteria.text: `node bin/envlint.mjs --schema <schema.json> <envfile>` reads both files given as arguments; `node --test test/cli.test.mjs` exits 0 (covers: REQ-7, REQ-20)
a run with no env file argument exits 2 with a usage line, even when the cwd holds a `.env` (covers: REQ-8)
`PORT=abc` with schema `{"PORT":{"type":"int"}}` prints a stdout line naming `PORT` and line 1, and exits 1 (covers: REQ-1, REQ-2)
a valid env file matching its schema prints nothing and exits 0 (covers: REQ-20)
a missing env file exits 2 with stderr naming the file and no stack trace (covers: REQ-3, REQ-6)
a missing schema file, and a schema file holding `{not json`, each exit 2 with stderr naming the schema file and no stack trace (covers: REQ-4, REQ-6)
an env file with no assignments (only comments/blank lines) and a schema with a required key exits 1 with one missing-key line, no crash (covers: REQ-5)
stdout and stderr contain no `\x1b[` escape sequence; the process never waits on stdin (covers: REQ-24)
after any run the env file's bytes and the fixture directory listing are unchanged (covers: REQ-22)
`A=${HOME}` with schema `{"A":{"enum":["x"]}}` reports the literal `${HOME}` (covers: REQ-23)
`bin/envlint.mjs` makes no network access — `grep -E "fetch|node:http|node:https|node:net" bin/envlint.mjs` finds nothing (covers: REQ-25)

tasks.title: Add the end-to-end integration test driving the binary

acceptance_criteria.text: `test/integration.test.mjs` spawns `node bin/envlint.mjs` against fixtures it writes to a temp dir; `npm test` exits 0 (covers: REQ-7)
it asserts exit 0 clean / 1 findings / 2 usage-or-I/O for each `TS-ERR-*` row of the use case (covers: REQ-2, REQ-3, REQ-4)

it asserts a fixture with every parse feature (comment, blank, `export`, both quote styles) and every rule (`required`, each `type`, `enum`) yields exactly the expected stdout lines (covers: REQ-1, REQ-9, REQ-16, REQ-17, REQ-18)
